ledger_owned.ACCOUNTING_CONFLICT: One source row received incompatible or duplicate outcomes; the ledger is blocking.
ledger_owned.DUPLICATE_ACCOUNTING_REF: Two closure rows resolve to the same registered table/key; the ledger is blocking.
ledger_owned.DUPLICATE_EXPLICIT_DISPOSITION: A future owner supplied more than one disposition for the same row; the ledger is blocking.
ledger_owned.EMITTED_CORE_SKOS: The row contributed to a validated emitted core semantic resource.
ledger_owned.EXPLICIT_REF_NOT_IN_CLOSURE: A future owner supplied a disposition for a row outside the validated closure; the ledger is blocking.
ledger_owned.HELD_RESOURCE_IN_STRONG_GRAPH: A held/rejected/unsupported semantic identity still appears as a strong RDF subject or collection member; the ledger is blocking.
ledger_owned.INVALID_PRIMARY_EXPLICIT_STATUS: A future owner tried to mark a primary semantic row EMITTED or IR_ONLY without builder proof; the ledger is blocking.
ledger_owned.INVALID_EMITTED_RESOURCE: BuildResult.emitted names an unresolved resource or lacks its required strong RDF type; the ledger is blocking.
ledger_owned.INVALID_EXPLICIT_STATUS: A future owner supplied a disposition outside the versioned status vocabulary; the ledger is blocking.
ledger_owned.IR_ONLY_SUPPORT: The row is supporting provenance/IR and has no standalone semantic resource in this compiler stage.
ledger_owned.MISSING_SEMANTIC_OUTCOME: An in-scope semantic row received no outcome; the ledger is blocking.
ledger_owned.NON_CORE_COMPOSITION_SEMANTICS: morpheme_compositions is explicit non-core unsupported debt for this compiler stage.
ledger_owned.OUT_OF_SCOPE_RECORD_REF: An upstream resolver/builder issue refers to a row outside the validated closure; the ledger is blocking.
ledger_owned.PROFILE_DIGEST_REQUIRED: A profile digest is required to interpret the ledger deterministically; the ledger is blocking.
ledger_owned.PROFILE_VERSION_REQUIRED: A profile version is required to interpret the ledger deterministically; the ledger is blocking.
ledger_owned.DUPLICATE_RESOLUTION_IRI: The resolution contains more than one resource object for one canonical IRI; the ledger is blocking.
ledger_owned.RESOLUTION_REF_MULTIPLE_IDENTITIES: One source row is attached to multiple resolved semantic identities; the ledger is blocking.
ledger_owned.UNACCOUNTED_STRONG_SEMANTIC_SUBJECT: The strong graph contains a Concept or root Resource subject not named in BuildResult.emitted; the ledger is blocking.
ledger_owned.UNSAFE_LEDGER_IDENTITY_FIELD: A stable identity field contains a URL/host-path form that cannot be emitted through the public ledger serializer; the value is preserved internally and serialization is rejected.
ledger_owned.UNKNOWN_MANIFEST_TABLE: The closure contains a future table without an explicit accounting policy; the ledger is blocking.

initial_semantic_reasons.INVALID_TARGET_REFERENCE: Future owner rejected an invalid semantic target.
initial_semantic_reasons.IRI_COLLISION: Distinct semantic identities collide on one IRI.
initial_semantic_reasons.NO_PUBLIC_SOURCE_LOCUS: No permissible public source locus supports strong RDF emission.
initial_semantic_reasons.NOTATION_COLLISION: Notation collision within the governing scheme.
initial_semantic_reasons.UNADMITTED_MAPPING: Mapping state is not admitted for strong SKOS mapping emission.
initial_semantic_reasons.UNSUPPORTED_RELATION: Relation is unsupported by the current semantic profile.

upstream_passthrough_policy: Stable reason codes produced by the identity resolver, source projector, and core builder are preserved verbatim in row entries. Multiple reasons for one row are retained in related_reason_codes while the row receives exactly one disposition.
serialization_boundary: table/key/source-ref/semantic-key identity fields are preserved exactly and never redacted; unsafe URL/host-path forms block and the public serializer rejects them. Canonical project semantic IRIs remain explicit. Free-text explanations, group issue details, and diagnostic details redact unsafe URL/local host-path text.
